en: Here before the Word And in awe I do Stand before
I obey the words Of life that I read I will worship our Lord
These recorded words Hold within a power Sanctifying us With the truth it tells
For eternity Holy words become Gospel truth and speaks For us all to hear
The one who fears the Lord And trembles at His Word
Risking their life Abiding by His word
This is who the Lord does seek This is the promise we believe
The one who puts their faith In the words of our God Following and Obeying our Lord
Those who will achieve His Kingdom on this land All churches arise For our Lord
The words of God Gives us all Wisdom for gaining Our full salvation
With my life and All my strength I will abide by His words now
